runs.text: Read a price in dollars and the exchange rate, and show the price in pesos.
The calculation is done by a pure function,
, which receives the dollars and the rate.

hints.text: Which sum turns dollars into pesos?
It is the function of the lesson: it knows nothing about networks.
The pesos are the dollars times the rate.
The algorithm reads the two numbers, calls the function and shows what it gives back. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Add a function that rounds the price up to the nearest ten.
The function is tested without a network: it is the part of the program that the app can check. A rate of 0 gives 0 pesos; it makes no real sense, but the sum handles it.

assertions.name: PrecioEnPesos
assertions.requirement: The function PrecioEnPesos, which receives the dollars and the rate, is missing.
